text: APPROVE: The extraction preserves behaviour (the old `break` out of the entries loop becomes a `return` from `ReadEntries`, and `EnqueueSubdirectories` still runs afterward), it removes the nested loops and try/catch blocks that drove the complexity, and it should build. The `#pragma warning restore CHA0004` moves to cover the new helpers. I could not check the types of `entries`, `subdirectories`, `files` and `unread` against the helper signatures, since only the diff was available.
